content.push(localize('sessionsChat.workspace', "Use Tab or Shift+Tab to navigate to the workspace picker and choose a workspace for your session. Needs attention links to customization migrations and MCP servers that require sign-in, showing up to two server names. Activate a server name to sign in directly; the sign-in count opens MCP server management. The footer offers Browse Additional and a settings gear named Change Button Location. Use Show or Focus Hover while the button is focused, then Tab or Shift+Tab to reach the links and Enter to activate them."));
